notes.problem: Flat copper islands with no scale and no readable link to epitaxial growth.
notes.fix: Model a single wafer on a susceptor with a raised epitaxial layer stepping up across its face, lit low from one side.

notes.problem: Two flat copper torn-paper shapes and crumbs on grooved black slats; reads as a sticker.
notes.fix: Replace it with a single wafer on the bench whose surface steps up in three or four raised epitaxial terraces, raked from the left.

notes.problem: The copper relief reads as two mountain silhouettes with scattered crumbs, not epitaxial growth, and is disconnected from the wafer motif.
notes.fix: Replace it with a single wafer under a raking side light, with a raised faceted epitaxial layer growing across half its face in copper.

notes.problem: A generic laptop backdrop, wafers fading and clipping along the bottom rail, a desk instead of a cluster.
notes.fix: Remove the laptop and stand the boat in front of one lit rack of server sleds, and fix the wafers' transparency or depth sort so every disc sits solid.

notes.problem: A stock laptop on a warm wood desk behind an unencoded run of wafers; a third material world.
notes.fix: Delete the laptop and the desk. Model one wafer lying flat on the black bench, cut into a lit die grid, with a hard side key so each die casts.

notes.problem: The 'servers' are drawn as another wafer boat with a screen.
notes.fix: Model a short rack of black server sleds on the same bench, one pulled out showing a bare socket.

notes.problem: A copper square on a textured grid under a flat black text band; the mono label sits directly on the art.
notes.fix: Run the relief full bleed under the type and raise the Lubbock County block with a cast shadow raking across the grid.

notes.problem: Stucco tile grid in the grey middle with busy texture under a black-on-copper label.
notes.fix: Drop the stucco displacement to a fine matte grain, sink the surrounding county tiles to near black, and light only the raised Lubbock tile from a low side.

notes.problem: A flat terracotta tile on a textured grid; the label sits on busy texture.
notes.fix: Model a lit relief of the Texas outline in dark stone with Lubbock County raised in copper, and seat the label in the quiet field beside it.
Light the plate from a low side source so the bolts and the empty IN SERVICE recess throw long shadows.

notes.problem: Reads like a form UI; the left rail extends below the plate frame.
notes.fix: Lower the key to a raking angle so the recess walls and rivets cast long shadows, and trim the left rail to end at the plate's lower border.

notes.problem: cast_fraction 0.136; reads as a flat UI form and the empty IN SERVICE slot is not lit as focal.
notes.fix: Drop the key to a low raking angle so the slots cast deep shadows, and put a single warm pool on the empty IN SERVICE recess.

notes.problem: The cover sits in a murky brown mid-tone; translucent wafers smear at 432 px.
notes.fix: Light the boat with one hard rim key from frame left onto opaque polished silicon against a black field, so each of the 19 edges catches a bright line.

notes.problem: Two boats of near-black wafers on a dark-grey floor with no bright edge.
notes.fix: Move the key light behind and to the left of the boats so every wafer top catches a lit arc, and darken the floor to true black.
